name: shackled-theurgist-p2-controlled-opponent-sacrifices-own-ally-stays-dead
notes: Shackled Theurgist (vkqzk1jik7, UMBRA CLERIC ally, 0 power / 2 life): "On Death: Target opponent may sacrifice an ally. If they don't, return Shackled Theurgist to the field. It gets +2 LIFE until end of turn and becomes ephemeral." The Theurgist is controlled by PLAYER 2 and killed for real by the opposing player's Drenching Finish (2 power vs 2 life); the On Death trigger resolves on the effect stack with the ambient playerID == the controller, but the opponent's YES/NO answer (and the follow-up handlers) run with the ambient playerID == the opponent. Pre-fix, ShackledTheurgistChoice/ShackledTheurgistReturn resolved the 'myField'/'theirField' zone names baked into the DQ params (relative to the controller) from the opponent's perspective: a No moved the opponent's own graveyard card onto the controller's field instead of returning the Theurgist, and a Yes offered the CONTROLLER's allies for sacrifice.

rulesClauses: On Death: Target opponent may sacrifice an ally. (accepted: only the opponent's own ally is offered)
If they don't, return Shackled Theurgist to the field. (they did, so it stays in the graveyard)

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Shackled Theurgist's On Death handlers resolved perspective-relative zone names in the wrong player's frame. The generated closure bakes 'myField'/'theirField' names (relative to the Theurgist's controller, the ambient playerID when the trigger resolves) into the ShackledTheurgistChoice DQ params, but that decision is answered by the OPPONENT (ambient playerID == the opponent). Live repro on HEAD: answering No moved the opponent's own graveyard card (Drenching Finish) onto the controller's field instead of returning the Theurgist (ShackledTheurgistReturn passed viewer-perspective graveyard names to MZMove, which flips them again when player != ambient), and answering Yes offered the CONTROLLER's allies for sacrifice instead of the opponent's own. Fix: only the controller's player number is trusted; zone names are rebuilt at read time relative to the ambient playerID, and ShackledTheurgistReturn() builds the MZMove (controller-perspective) and AddTurnEffect (viewer-perspective) ids separately.
